items.text: Hi everyone!

A new patch is live! Alongside further accessibility improvements, our early end-of-year post-launch update focuses on addressing additional reported bugs and optimizing the overall gameplay experience:
Fixed an issue where picking up the basket after purchasing something at Karl's gas station could cause the animation and sound effects play twice.
Fixed an issue where the jukebox in the Highway Star Diner chapter displayed the incorrect album cover despite the correct song being selected.
Fixed a softlock that prevented players from progressing through a vignette by taking a picture after finding the furry perpetrator in the trash area behind the Highway Star diner.
Fixed a rare edge case where Sam would remain in place after Alfred finished watering the plants, resulting in a softlock.
Fixed a potential softlock on lower-end devices that could occur when pushing through the turnstile at Marley's resort.
Fixed a rare pathfinding issue that allowed Doggo to block Alfred at the foot of the stairs inside the Captain's Galley restaurant.
Fixed an issue where some claw machine sound effects in the resort's arcade would continue playing indefinitely after the machine broke down.
Fixed a visual bug in the Resort chapter where the souvenir shop's front door appeared to have a broken lock even before Alfred had interacted with it.
Removed the zoom requirement during the Charles bench segment of the hike to the lighthouse to make this section flow a little better.
Fixed an issue where some dialogue would get cut off if Alfred entered a cutscene early during his hike to Winslow lighthouse.
Fixed an issue where Alfred would briefly appear to levitate when entering the lighthouse in the Coast chapter.
Fixed an issue where Alfred was able to take out his camera or journal during vignette sequences.

Fixed an issue where the music playing in the car during the prologue chapter at the waterfall, as well as the needle drop in the epilogue scene, did not properly respect the Music volume slider in Options.
Fixed a potential softlock that could occur when Alfred picked up sticks that were wobbling on the ground. The world's physics have been restored.
Various minor fixes and improvements
Find the full list of fixes for all platforms here: https://forever-ago.com/patch-notes/
It's been quite a journey so far, and we're beyond grateful to have you along for the ride. Thank you for being part of it.
Your support means more to us than you know!
Hi everyone!
Today's update focuses on addressing the most commonly reported findings and improving the overall gameplay experience:
Optimized the sound mixing of character voices across the board. While Alfred may not be the youngest anymore, he should still be able to understand the people around him.

Actions relevant to achievements are now correctly counted in Chapter Select as well. This is especially useful if you want to revisit chapters to collect any missing vignettes or resting opportunities.
Fixed an issue where photos taken during gameplay would sometimes be missing from the Journal Photo Selection sequence.
Fixed a rare issue where taking a photo within a vignette would prevent the sequence from progressing.
Fixed various text rendering issues with Asian languages.
Fixed an issue where Alfred's arms would sometimes disappear when opening the Journal, making it look like he had mastered the art of telekinesis.
Fixed an issue where look sensitivity settings were not correctly applied to the in-camera controls.
Fixed a rare issue where a cutscene might not trigger if Alfred tightened the bolts too quickly in the Sam's Detour chapter.
Fixed an issue where the cutscene in Sam's chapter would sometimes fail to continue if a selfie was taken too quickly.

Fixed an issue where it was possible to interact with the resort's entrance turnstile again after reloading a checkpoint, essentially trapping Alfred in an endless loop of never escaping Marley's resort.
Fixed an issue where the interaction marker at the resort's boat shed was harder to trigger than intended.
Fixed an issue where the Guardian Lord music from the arcade could continue playing indefinitely during normal gameplay (it was fun while it lasted...).
Fixed a very unfortunate and rare issue where the music in the Mountain chapter would briefly pause during a Trauma sequence.
\[STEAM DECK] Added a Quit button to the main menu and included the previously missing left-hand layout option.
Various minor fixes and improvements
Find the full list of fixes for all platforms here: https://forever-ago.com/patch-notes/
